FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE
THE order under Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), as amended by Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No.56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3 of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amendedby Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, I,Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment do by this Order declare the Ethugala Forestof 55.470 hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedule hereto as Ethugala Reserved Forest from 24th day ofApril, 2018.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment.
Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment,Battaramulla,24th April 2018.
